purpose: Canonical, machine-checked inventory of works whose definitions, theorem families, or proof architecture are directly formalized, actively scaffolded, or inherited by the DKPS and raw-response Quench development.
scope_rule: Include every DKPS-lineage paper whose definitions or theorems are used by a paper-facing Lean namespace.
Include primary historical papers for theorem families explicitly formalized or actively scaffolded under ForMathlib.
Include modern books/surveys only when repository code cites them as a theorem-level reference.
Do not include empirical application citations that contribute no formalized definition, theorem, or proof step.

status_legend.transcription_only: A transcription exists, but not a proof-level reconstruction.
status_legend.source_text_only: Source prose/TeX exists, but not a proof-level reconstruction.
status_legend.core_note: A broad core-arguments note exists and should be upgraded to the common manifest/anchor format.
status_legend.transcription_sufficient: An exact source-order transcription plus a maintained formalization-versus-literature ledger is sufficient; a second distilled note would be duplicative.

role_legend.direct_target: A DKPS/Quench paper whose named results are formalization targets.
role_legend.inherited_foundation: A paper supplying definitions or population geometry inherited by a direct target.
role_legend.primary_method_source: A primary paper supplying a mathematical method used inside a direct target.
role_legend.primary_theorem_source: The primary source for a theorem family implemented under ForMathlib.
role_legend.supporting_source: A supporting paper used to audit, extend, or compare a formalized theorem family.
role_legend.modern_comparison: A later comparison/generalization useful for statement and constant audits.
role_legend.lineage_background: Earlier programmatic work that may explain inherited definitions but is not yet confirmed as a theorem target.
role_legend.future_extension: A source for an explicitly retained future arbitrary-dimensional extension.
role_legend.related_upstream: A natural mathlib-facing endpoint of infrastructure introduced for DKPS, not required by a paper proof.
role_legend.reference_work: A book or monograph used as a theorem-level reference or audit source.

bibliographic_status_legend.verified: Core bibliographic identity has been checked against a repository citation, DOI/arXiv record, or reliable catalog.
bibliographic_status_legend.needs_verification: Identity is plausible but exact title, venue, pages, edition, or stable source still needs confirmation.
